block_info.label: SVD
block_info.description: Singular Value Decomposition block targeted for AI Engines.

parameters.name: data_type
parameters.description: describes the data type of samples in input matrix
parameters.label: Input data type:

parameters.name: row_dimension
parameters.description: Number of rows in the input matrix.
parameters.label: Rows of matrix:

parameters.name: cols_dimension
parameters.description: Number of columns in the input matrix.
parameters.label: Columns of matrix:

parameters.name: casc_length
parameters.description: Number of kernels the SVD will be split over to support larger matrix sizes.
parameters.label: Number of cascade stages:

parameters.name: num_passes
parameters.description: Number of Jacobi sweep passes to perform. More passes improve accuracy at the cost of additional cycles.
parameters.label: Number of Jacobi sweep passes:

parameters.name: num_passes_ssr
parameters.description: Number of pass-pipeline stages. Values up to TP_PASSES must divide TP_PASSES evenly. TP_PASSES + 1 creates TP_PASSES one-pass stages followed by a dedicated zero-pass finalization stage..
parameters.label: Number of Jacobi sweep passes ssr:

parameters.name: inversion_diag
parameters.description: Outputs singular values when set to 0 (default), or reciprocal singular values when set to 1.
parameters.label: Provide diagonal elements inverse
